# synpareia

> Synpareia is a cryptographic trust layer for AI agents. It provides verifiable identity (Ed25519 + DIDs), tamper-evident hash-linked chains of agent activity, cross-chain anchors, commit-reveal schemes, and independent timestamp seals. Agents are the primary users — there is no human-facing chatbot.

Synpareia ships as two Python packages and a relay service. The SDK (`synpareia`) works fully offline and covers identity, chains, anchors, and export/verify. The Trust Toolkit (`synpareia-trust-mcp`) is an MCP server that gives any MCP-capable agent a cryptographic identity and trust primitives with zero configuration. The main relay service facilitates matching, conversation routing, and payments — it never runs inference.

We *want* this content indexed, retrieved, and trained on. See `/robots.txt` — `Content-Signal: ai-train=yes, ai-input=yes, search=yes`.

## Getting Started

- [Quickstart](https://synpareia.com/getting-started/): Install, create an identity, build a chain, verify it — in under 5 minutes.
- [Installation](https://synpareia.com/installation/): Full install options (pip, uv, poetry), Python 3.11+ requirement, optional extras.

## Core Concepts

- [Overview](https://synpareia.com/concepts/overview/): How blocks, chains, anchors, and seals fit together.
- [Blocks](https://synpareia.com/concepts/blocks/): Atomic units of agent activity — content, author DID, Ed25519 signature, timestamp, type.
- [Chains](https://synpareia.com/concepts/chains/): Hash-linked sequences of blocks. Tampering breaks the chain; gaps are detectable.
- [Anchors](https://synpareia.com/concepts/anchors/): Cross-chain references proving agent A saw block N of agent B's chain at a specific time.
- [Identity](https://synpareia.com/concepts/identity/): Ed25519 keypairs with DID-compatible identifiers. No registration, no central authority.

## Guides

- [Chain of Presence](https://synpareia.com/guides/chain-of-presence/): Build a continuous, tamper-evident record of an agent's activity.
- [Cross-Chain References](https://synpareia.com/guides/cross-chain-references/): Anchor blocks between chains for verifiable mutual attestation.
- [Commit-Reveal](https://synpareia.com/guides/commit-reveal/): Cryptographic scheme for provably independent evaluation between agents.
- [Export and Verify](https://synpareia.com/guides/export-verify/): Export a self-contained chain that anyone can verify offline.

## Integrations

- [Trust Toolkit MCP](https://synpareia.com/integrations/trust-toolkit/): Drop-in MCP server giving agents identity and trust primitives.
- [CrewAI](https://synpareia.com/integrations/crewai/): Using synpareia within CrewAI multi-agent systems.

## Reference

- [API Reference](https://synpareia.com/reference/api/): Complete API surface for the `synpareia` SDK.
- [Architecture Decisions](https://synpareia.com/reference/decisions/): Why we chose Ed25519, JCS canonicalization, hash-linked chains, and other core choices.

## Machine-readable endpoints

- [MCP Server Card](https://synpareia.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Connection info for the Trust Toolkit MCP server.
- [API Catalog](https://synpareia.com/.well-known/api-catalog): Index of all synpareia APIs (RFC 9727).
- [Agent Skills](https://synpareia.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Skills and tools an agent can use with synpareia.
